title: C: Template Engine (Simulated)
description: Build a simple template engine that replaces {{placeholders}} with values.

steps.title: Simple Template Replacement
steps.description: Write a function `void render(char *template, char *key, char *val)` that finds `{{key}}` in the template string and replaces it with the value. Test: 'Hello, {{name}}!' with key=name, val=World.
hints: Copy text before, insert value, copy text after.
